tool_config.name: find_open_requests
tool_config.description: Look up the calling Foreman's own Requests when they ask about the status of one. Returns them newest first as [{"ref": "R-1042", "job": "Route 104 Widening", "category": "Trucking", "need": "tri-axle dump trucks", "quantity": 3, "unit": "trucks", "needed_by": "Monday, November 2 at 7:00 AM", "status": "Acknowledged", "owner": "Dispatch", "outcome": null, "explanation": null}]. status is one of Recorded, Acknowledged, In Progress, Resolved; outcome and explanation are set only when Resolved. An empty list [] means no Request matches. Returns {"error": "..."} if the Requests could not be looked up.

request_body_schema.description: Optional filters from what the Foreman said. Send none of them when he did not name a Job or a kind of need.

job_id.description: The job_id find_jobs returned for the Job the Foreman named. Leave it out unless find_jobs returned exactly one Job.

category.description: The Category of the need the Foreman asks about, for example Trucking for 'that truck'. Leave it out when unclear.
